_comment: Proves the checkRequiredMeasurements()-equivalent check runs before any mutation. measurements_incomplete.smis omits 'shoulder_length', the one measurement base_pattern.val's A1 formula needs. Dumps both before and after the failed load so run_tests.sh's check_05 function can diff them and confirm VContainer/doc were left byte-identical -- not just that the action reported failure, but that it genuinely mutated nothing. Also asserts the failed action's error is the structured {'type':'missingMeasurements','missing':[...]} shape, naming 'shoulder_length' specifically.
